# Fixtures for `mbtiles` (MBTiles tileset)

Files made for whiff's tests for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour), CC0-1.0 unless the table says otherwise. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/geo.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `saltmere-chart-raster.mbtiles` | ogr2ogr / gdal_translate -f MBTILES (GDAL 3.10; vector and raster) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-chart.mbtiles` | gdal_translate -of MBTILES (GDAL 3.10), from scripts/fixtures/db.sh | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-vector.mbtiles` | ogr2ogr / gdal_translate -f MBTILES (GDAL 3.10; vector and raster) | CC0-1.0 |
